topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: Global npm install of its-magic 0.1.2-40 on Linux fails: its-magic --mode missing exits with [INSTALL_MANIFEST_ERROR] install_include_paths section is empty despite manifest listing paths.

installer.sh get_manifest_paths uses awk with exact [section] match; packaged template/docs/engineering/context/installer-owned-paths.manifest ships CRLF; .gitattributes currently forces LF only for *.sh (US-0084).
Fix must preserve POSIX /bin/sh and dash compatibility; prefer LF at source via gitattributes plus defensive CR strip in parser so tarballs tolerate CRLF.
Add automated check: CRLF manifest fixture still resolves install_include_paths, or prepublish rejects CR in manifest; extend installer tests / guard_installer_publish as appropriate.
npm pack / global install on Debian: cat -A shows no ^M on manifest lines; its-magic missing mode runs without INSTALL_MANIFEST_ERROR.
